signing.key_rotation: new signing keys must be published in JWKS before tokens using them are issued

lifetime.refresh_model: issue a new short-lived service credential; do not extend an existing token

scope_boundaries.mesh.platform-registry.read: read normalized authority-preserving Platform Registry records; does not grant producer mutation or domain authority
scope_boundaries.mesh.platform-registry.write: submit only the authenticated component's own Platform Registry record; GoreeCloud Mesh enforces service_id == component.id and does not transfer producer authority

security_requirements: private signing keys never leave GoreeCloud Identity
producer systems must not self-sign, mint, or substitute GoreeCloud Mesh service credentials
tokens must not contain user content, secrets, backup payloads, prompts, or private application data
service_id must match the authenticated workload identity represented by sub
consumers must validate signature, issuer, audience, expiry, not-before, service identity, and required scope
platform registry write credentials must remain workload-bound and must not authorize one service to publish another component's record
unknown kid, unsupported algorithm, missing required claim, malformed scope, or invalid temporal claim must fail closed
deployment_boundary: Runtime token issuance and JWKS generation are implemented, including the scoped Platform Registry read/write permissions required by the current Mesh Platform Registry API. Production acceptance requires durable Identity-managed signing-key storage, a deployed JWKS endpoint, live workload-bound service-token issuance, rotation/revocation evidence, and successful end-to-end Mesh verification.
